claude_initial_call: CONTESTED; Occam alternative = pre-existing convertible subset is selected

audit.primary_source_citation: Gao Y, Souza-Fonseca-Guimaraes F, Bald T, ... Holzel M, Smyth MJ. "Tumor immunoevasion by the conversion of effector NK cells into type 1 innate lymphoid cells." Nat Immunol. 2017 Sep;18(9):1004-1015. PMID 28759001, DOI 10.1038/ni.3800. CARRIES AN AUTHOR CORRECTION: Nat Immunol 2024 May;25(5):925-926, PMID 38514890, DOI 10.1038/s41590-024-01799-9. Companion/secondary (NOT the primary for the intratumoural claim): Cortez VS et al., Nat Immunol 2017;18:995-1003, PMID 28759002, PMCID PMC5712491. Hint source Dadi S et al. Cell 2016;164:365-377 (PMID 26806130) was checked and is MISATTRIBUTED for this claim - it concerns tissue-resident ILC1 and innate-like T cells in tumour immunosurveillance, and does not assert NK-to-ILC1 conversion.
audit.fulltext_unavailable_reason: Gao 2017 is CLOSED access (Semantic Scholar openAccessPdf status=CLOSED; EuropePMC/PMC return abstract only; nature.com Online Methods behind paywall; hal.science mirror returned Access Denied). I did NOT paraphrase the abstract: I reconstructed the design from the publisher's per-figure legend pages (nature.com/articles/ni.3800/figures/1-6), which returned legend text including recipient strains, route, timepoints and per-panel n, plus the full Author Correction text. The narrative Online Methods (sort gate purity, antibody clones, exact cell doses) remains unobtained. Cortez 2017 methods WERE fully obtained via PMC5712491. Park 2019 (eLife) full text obtained OA and archived.
audit.species: Mouse (C57BL/6 wild-type; Rag2-/-Il2rg(gc)-/-; CD45.1/CD45.2 congenics; Ncr1-iCre x Tgfbr2-fl/fl ["RII-FL"]; Ncr1-iCre x constitutively-active Tgfbr1 ["RI-CA-FL"]; Ncr1-iCre x Mcl1-fl). Limited correlative human data (GIST/melanoma). Counter-evidence source PMC13035902 is human colorectal cancer.
audit.what_was_measured: In mouse, in MCA1956 methylcholanthrene-induced fibrosarcoma, sorted splenic CD45.2+ NK cells were injected INTRATUMOURALLY into CD45.1+ tumour-bearing congenic hosts at day 14 and, at days 18-21, donor(CD45.2)-gated cells were scored by flow cytometry for the surface markers CD49a and CD49b plus intracellular Eomes, to count donor-derived CD49a+CD49b+Eomes+ "intILC1" and CD49a+CD49b-Eomes-int "ILC1" events, in n=3-4 recipient mice per timepoint (Fig 4d-g). In a parallel in-vivo arm, sorted NK cells from Ncr1-iCre Tgfbr2-fl/fl vs Tgfbr2-WT donors were transferred i.v. into MCA1956-bearing Rag2-/-gc-/- hosts at day 3 and the same CD49a/CD49b/Eomes marker composition was read at day 18 in n=6 recipient mice (Fig 4a-c), or transferred intratumourally into CD45.1+ hosts and read at day 21 in n=5-7 recipient mice (Fig 4h-j). Supporting readouts: RNA-seq of six matched triplicates of NK/intILC1/ILC1 sorted from the same MCA1956 tumour (n=6 tumours, Fig 1); Ki67 staining of donor-derived group 1 ILC subsets in the LIVER (not tumour) of Rag2-/-gc-/- hosts at 7 d (n=3 host mice) and 14 d (n=4 host mice) after NK transfer (Fig 3e); and in-vitro culture of sorted splenic NK cells with IL-15 +/- TGF-beta1 scored for the same CD49a/CD49b/Eomes markers in n=3 replicates (Fig 2c). No cell was ever individually tracked from an NK state to an ILC1 state.
audit.n: Fig 4a-c n=6 recipient mice; Fig 4d-g n=3-4 recipient mice per timepoint; Fig 4h-j n=7 (RII-WT) and n=5 (RII-FL) recipient mice; Fig 4k-l n=20 mice pooled from five experiments; Fig 3e n=3 (day 7) and n=4 (day 14) host mice; Fig 2a n=9 (d7), n=8 (d14), n=4 (d21); Fig 2b n=8; Fig 2c n=3 culture replicates; Fig 2d n=4/4/3; Fig 1 n=6 tumours (six matched sorted triplicates). Cortez 2017: typically 1-3 mice per genotype per timepoint, plus a single SMAD4-mutant human donor (n=1 person).
audit.n_unit: recipient/host mice (animals) for all transfer experiments; tumours for the RNA-seq (n=6 tumours); culture replicates for the in-vitro arm; 1 human donor for the Cortez SMAD4 polyposis patient. NOT cells.
audit.controls: (1) Congenic CD45.1 host / CD45.2 donor discrimination, so donor-derived output is separable from host cells. (2) Rag2-/-gc-/- recipients lack endogenous NK/ILC, removing host-derived ILC1 as a source. (3) Genetic requirement control: Tgfbr2-floxed (RII-FL) vs Tgfbr2-WT (RII-WT) donor NK cells, and Ncr1-cre/wt Cre-only controls. (4) In vitro: IL-15 alone vs IL-15 + TGF-beta1. (5) Functional arms used ctrl IgG vs anti-asGM1 depletion. NOTABLY ABSENT: no purity/contamination quantification of the sorted input NK gate reported in the legends; no non-tumour-bearing transfer control for the intratumoural arm; no clonal, barcode, or inducible genetic fate-mapping control. Ncr1-iCre is used only to delete genes, never as a fate map - and it could not serve as one, since ILC1s also express NKp46.
audit.methods_quote: Fig 3e legend (verbatim from publisher figure page): "Flow cytometry of NK cell-derived group 1 ILC subsets in the liver of Rag2-/-gc-/- mice at 7 d (n = 3 host mice) and 14 d (n = 4 host mice) after the transfer of NK cells, assessing Ki67 expression." || Author Correction (PMID 38514890), verbatim: "The data from the underlying experiments are believed to have been fabricated or are unreliable, respectively." and "The major finding of the paper that TGF-beta-driven conversion of NK cells into ILC1s is a novel mechanism by which tumors escape surveillance by the innate immune system remains unaffected. No concerns have been raised regarding other data in the paper." || Park et al. eLife 2019 (PMID 31393266) Results, verbatim from archived full text: "NK cells upregulated CD49a upon transfer into Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- mice, as previously reported" and, on Gao 2017 specifically: "There was no evidence presented that these Eomes- cells can circulate, though they proliferate when adoptively transferred into lymphocyte-deficient hosts. Moreover, it is not clear if these cells persist in the absence of tumor."
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: SELECTION/EXPANSION OF A PRE-EXISTING CONVERTIBLE SUBSET WITHIN THE SORTED INPUT, which the design cannot exclude. All transfers were BULK and polyclonal - no barcoding, no clonal tracking, no inducible fate map - so a donor-derived CD49a+ output is equally consistent with outgrowth of a minor CD49a-low/intermediate or intILC1-primed contaminant inside the live sort gate as with conversion of the average NK cell. Three specific reasons this is not a pedantic worry: (i) the live sort gate cannot have included Eomes, which is intracellular and requires fixation, so the "CD49a-CD49b+Eomes+" input population was defined post hoc, not purified; the legends report no purity or contamination figure. (ii) The paper's OWN Fig 3 establishes that intILC1s have the GREATEST proliferative capacity (highest Ki67) among group 1 ILC subsets - differential proliferation is precisely the mechanism that converts a sub-1% contaminant into a dominant recovered population, and it is here documented by the authors themselves. (iii) For the Rag2-/-gc-/- arms (Figs 3e, 4a-c), CD49a upregulation is a documented GENERIC artefact of transfer into lymphopenic hosts, independent of tumour or TGF-beta - stated explicitly by Park et al. eLife 2019 as "previously reported" - so in those panels the ILC1-defining marker is confounded by lymphopenia-driven homeostatic proliferation and tissue lodging. The one arm that is genuinely resistant to the lymphopenia artefact is the intratumoural CD45.1/CD45.2 congenic transfer into immunocompetent tumour-bearing hosts (Fig 4d-g), and that arm rests on n=3-4 recipient mice and a purely marker-defined output. Secondary alternative: TWO INDEPENDENT ORIGINS - tumour ILC1s seeded from ILC precursors rather than from mature NK cells (see counter_evidence).
audit.counter_evidence: FOUND, on three fronts. (1) RESEARCH-INTEGRITY COUNTER-EVIDENCE, which the initial call missed entirely: Gao 2017 carries a 2024 Author Correction (PMID 38514890) removing Figs 5e and 6d,e and Supplementary Figs 5c,d and 8c after an independent investigation commissioned by QIMR Berghofer concluded no evidence of the experiments' conduct or primary data could be confirmed and that the underlying data "are believed to have been fabricated or are unreliable." From the figure legends I retrieved, the removed panels are exactly the FUNCTIONAL consequence experiments - Fig 5e MCA carcinogenesis incidence in Ncr1-cre/RII-WT/RII-FL mice at 300 ug MCA; Fig 6d,e RM-1 prostate-cancer lung metastasis in RI-CA and Mcl1 models with anti-asGM1 vs IgG. So the "converted ILC1s fail to control tumours" half of the claim now rests on withdrawn data. Senior author Mark Smyth was found by QIMR Berghofer to have "seriously breached Codes relating to responsible research conduct," resigned in 2021, and has multiple retractions elsewhere (JCI, Clin Transl Immunology) attributed to fabricated figures. The correction asserts the conversion conclusion "remains unaffected," but that assertion is the authors'/journal's, not an independent replication. (2) ALTERNATIVE-ORIGIN COUNTER-EVIDENCE: PMID 41896575 / PMC13035902 (2026), human colorectal cancer, ~23,400 ILC/NK cells scRNA-seq from 11 patients (19 tissue samples), flow validation in 8 patients, OP9-DL1/Caco-2 differentiation assays from 24 patients - concludes tumour ILC1/trNK-like cells arise substantially from LOCAL DIFFERENTIATION OF IMMATURE PRECURSORS ("naive ILCs" and "early NK cells") seeding the tumour, not solely from conversion of mature NK. Its own evidence is INF_TRAJECTORY (RNA velocity/pseudotime) plus INF_INVITRO, so it weakens rather than refutes. Also PMID 35348580 (Ly49E separates liver ILC1s into embryo-derived and postnatal subsets) supports independent origins for the ILC1 pool. (3) SCOPE COUNTER-EVIDENCE: Park et al. eLife 2019 (PMID 31393266), the field's cleanest NK-to-ILC1 conversion study (Eomes-GFP reporter, Ncr1-iCre Eomes-fl/fl, WT:Tbx21-/- mixed BM chimeras), is an INFECTION model, not a tumour, and explicitly flags that Gao's tumour Eomes- cells were never shown to circulate or to persist in the absence of tumour. That same paper concedes that true Eomes fate mapping was not achievable (EomesCre unusable due to ubiquitous developmental expression) and that transfer of congenic NK cells before infection failed to yield recoverable cells - i.e., nobody in this literature has closed the loop.
audit.downstream_dependency: Named, concrete dependents: (1) Cortez VS et al., "SMAD4 impedes the conversion of NK cells into ILC1-like cells," Nat Immunol 2017;18:995-1003 (PMID 28759002) - the back-to-back companion paper, which cites Gao 2017 directly and frames its own SMAD4 phenotype as the same NK-to-ILC1 conversion axis, despite its own methods containing NO adoptive transfer and NO fate mapping (verified in PMC5712491 methods; its tumour readout is B16-F10 lung metastasis focus counts at day 15). (2) Souza-Fonseca-Guimaraes F, Cursons J, Huntington ND, "The NK cell-cancer cycle," Nat Immunol 2020 (DOI 10.1038/s41590-020-0728-z), co-authored by Gao 2017 authors, which embeds TGF-beta-driven NK-to-ILC1 conversion as a canonical evasion step. (3) The therapeutic rationale for combining TGF-beta/TGFbR1 blockade with NK-cell and CAR-NK adoptive therapy to "prevent NK dedifferentiation" rests on this claim. (4) Ducimetiere L et al., "Cxcr3 promotes protection from colorectal cancer liver metastasis by driving NK cell infiltration and plasticity," J Clin Invest 2025 (PMID 40168086, PMC12126236), which interprets intratumoural CD49a+ NK cells through the Gao conversion framework. (5) Interleukin-35 paper PMID 40610398 (Nat Commun 2025) explicitly models "ILC1-like conversion" of human NK cells on this precedent.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: Claude's verdict ("CONTESTED; Occam alternative is that a pre-existing convertible subset is SELECTED") lands on the right conclusion but for incomplete and partly wrong reasons, and misses the decisive fact. THREE CORRECTIONS. (a) Claude implicitly under-rated the evidence class. Gao 2017 is NOT a marker-similarity or trajectory paper. It contains a genuine OBS_TRANSFER: sorted CD45.2+ splenic NK cells injected intratumourally into CD45.1+ tumour-bearing immunocompetent congenic hosts, with donor-gated recovery of CD49a+ intILC1/ILC1 (Fig 4d-g), plus an OBS_GENETIC requirement (Tgfbr2-deleted donor NK cells fail to generate the ILC1 output, Fig 4h-j). Under the A.3 rubric that is the second-strongest class available, not an inferential one. The hint's suspicion that this was "phenotype shift in bulk populations" is wrong. (b) BUT Claude's alternative survives regardless, because transfer was bulk and polyclonal with no barcoding, no clonal tracking and no inducible fate map, and because the authors' own Fig 3 shows intILC1s are the most proliferative group 1 ILC subset - so selective outgrowth of a minor pre-existing contaminant in the sort gate is not excluded. Additionally, in the two Rag2-/-gc-/- arms the ILC1-defining marker CD49a is a documented generic artefact of transfer into lymphopenic hosts (Park eLife 2019). The hint's question "was any genetic fate-mapping tool used (Ncr1-cre, Eomes reporter)?" resolves as NO: Ncr1-iCre appears only as a gene-deletion driver, and it could not function as a fate map anyway because ILC1s also express NKp46. Searched specifically for true fate mapping of the NK-to-ILC1 axis and found none, in tumours or otherwise; the closest attempt (Park 2019) reports that Eomes-Cre fate mapping was not feasible. (c) THE FINDING NEITHER CLAUDE NOR THE HINTS FLAGGED, and the most important output of this audit: the primary source carries a 2024 Author Correction (PMID 38514890) that REMOVED Figs 5e and 6d,e and Supplementary Figs 5c,d and 8c because a QIMR Berghofer investigation could confirm no evidence the experiments were conducted and concluded the data "are believed to have been fabricated or are unreliable"; senior author Mark Smyth was found to have seriously breached research-conduct codes and has retractions in other journals for fabricated figures. Those removed panels are the tumour-incidence and metastasis-control readouts - i.e., the "and this lets tumours escape" half of the claim is now unsupported by published data, even though the conversion half is untouched by the correction. The claim should therefore be graded CONTESTED for a stronger reason than Claude gave: not merely that a cleaner alternative exists, but that the sole primary source is partially withdrawn for suspected fabrication, has never been replicated with lineage tracing by an independent group, and its intact conversion evidence rests on n=3-4 recipient mice in the one arm free of the lymphopenia artefact.
audit.notes: Provenance: full texts archived under /home/user/aaa/refs/ as T4_28759001.txt (Gao, abstract+metadata only - paywalled), T4_PMC5712491.txt (Cortez), T4_38514890.txt (Author Correction record), T4_PMC6703900.txt (Park eLife 2019, full OA text, 74,788 bytes). Gao figure legends were obtained from the publisher figure pages, reachable only by following the idp.nature.com redirect chain and appending ?error=cookies_not_supported. Distinguishing searched-vs-not per G3: I SEARCHED AND READ counter-evidence and found it (status FOUND). I SEARCHED for a true genetic fate-mapping study of the NK-to-ILC1 axis (two dedicated queries) and found none - that is a searched-and-absent result, not an assumption. I searched for and could not locate a Yulong Gao thesis in a UQ/QIMR repository that would have carried the verbatim Online Methods; the HAL mirror (hal-01765092) exists but returned Access Denied, and ResearchGate/Sci-Hub routes were not used. Hint accuracy: Gao 2017 and Cortez 2017 are correctly identified; Dadi 2016 is misattributed to this claim. Note also that Cortez 2017's phenotype is a GAIN of an ILC1-like gene signature upon Smad4 deletion, i.e. it is INF_MARKER on a knockout background rather than the canonical OBS_GENETIC pattern of "knock out gene, B fails to appear," and its methods contain no transfer and no fate mapping.

adv.challenge_reason:
I re-pulled the primary source myself rather than trusting the row. `lit.py methods 28759001 --tag T4` returns STATUS=ABSTRACT_ONLY (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/T4_28759001.txt); nature.com/articles/ni.3800 via the idp.nature.com redirect chain confirms the narrative Online Methods are paywalled ("Only the abstract and figure thumbnails are accessible"). So the design can only be reconstructed from per-figure legend pages, as the auditor said. On that basis:

STRONGEST CLASS = OBS_TRANSFER: UPHELD. Fig 4d legend, verbatim from the publisher figure page: "CD45.1+ mice were given subcutaneous transplantation of MCA1956 cells on day 0, followed by intratumoral (i.t.) injection of CD45.2+ splenic NK cells on day 14 and analysis on days 18 and 21." That is literally "transfer A, recover B in recipient" in an immunocompetent congenic host. It is NOT marker similarity alone, NOT in vitro, NOT pseudotime. No OBS_DIRECT exists (no barcoding, no clonal tracking, no inducible fate map), so OBS_TRANSFER is correctly the ceiling. OBS_GENETIC is defensible for Fig 4h-j (Tgfbr2-deleted DONOR NK cells fail to yield the output; n=7 RII-WT vs n=5 RII-FL, P<0.05) though it is a within-transfer modifier, not an independent genetic lineage test, and it is a partial reduction rather than an absence.

BUT THREE MATERIAL ERRORS IN THE ROW, one of which narrows the claim:

(1) THE ROW MISSTATES WHAT THE CLEAN ARM MEASURED. The row's what_was_measured says Fig 4d-g scored "donor-derived CD49a+CD49b+Eomes+ 'intILC1' AND CD49a+CD49b-Eomes-int 'ILC1' events." The legend says otherwise. Verbatim: "(e) Flow cytometry of host (CD45.1+) and donor (CD45.2+) tumor group 1 ILC subsets (above plots) from host mice as in d at day 18 or 21. (f) Quantification of NK cell-derived intILC1s as in e." Only intILC1 is quantified. Donor-derived bona fide ILC1 (CD49a+CD49b-Eomes-int) is NOT reported in the intratumoural immunocompetent arm. Consequence: the ONE arm free of the lymphopenia confound establishes, at OBS_TRANSFER grade, only NK -> intILC1 — an intermediate that still expresses CD49b and Eomes, i.e. still NK-like. Donor-derived terminal ILC1 in a tumour is reported only in the Rag2-/-gc-/- arm (Fig 4a-c, i.v., day 3 -> day 18, n=6), which is exactly the arm confounded by lymphopenia-driven CD49a upregulation. So the claim as literally stated — "NK -> ILC1 inside tumours" — has its clean OBS_TRANSFER support only for the intermediate state, and its ILC1 endpoint only in an empty-niche host.

(2) THE ROW'S PROVENANCE CLAIM FOR CORTEZ IS FALSE AS WRITTEN. It states "Cortez 2017 methods WERE fully obtained via PMC5712491." The archived file /home/user/aaa/refs/T4_PMC5712491.txt carries the header "# status=ABSTRACT_ONLY pmid=28759002 pmcid=PMC5712491" — it is abstract + reference list only. I independently re-fetched pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5712491 and the row's SUBSTANTIVE conclusions do hold: no adoptive transfer anywhere in Cortez; Ncr1-iCre and Il7r-Cre appear only as conditional-deletion drivers with no Rosa26 reporter, so no fate map; B16-F10 readout is "1 x 10^5 B16-F10 ... injected into the tail vein ... At day 15 ... tumor foci were quantified in the lungs." n is weak: "one to three mice per genotype," microarray "n = 3 biological replicates." So the conclusion survives but the stated provenance does not.

(3) THE ROW'S CENTRAL NEGATIVE SEARCH CLAIM IS FALSE — see new_counter_evidence. It asserts "Searched specifically for true fate mapping of the NK-to-ILC1 axis and found none, in tumours or otherwise." Such a study exists and is directly contradictory.
adv.revised_evidence_type_strongest: OBS_TRANSFER — but scope-limited. Full set present: OBS_TRANSFER (Fig 4a-c i.v. into Rag2-/-gc-/-, n=6 recipient mice; Fig 4d-f i.t. into CD45.1 immunocompetent hosts, n=3 at d18 / n=4 at d21 recipient mice), OBS_GENETIC (Fig 4h-j, Tgfbr2-null donor NK cells, n=7 vs n=5 recipient mice, P<0.05 — within-transfer, partial), INF_INVITRO (Fig 2c, sorted splenic NK + IL-15 +/- TGF-beta1, n=3 culture replicates), INF_MARKER (the entire NK/intILC1/ILC1 taxonomy is CD49a/CD49b/Eomes surface+intracellular staining; the Fig 1 RNA-seq of six matched sorted triplicates, n=6 tumours, is marker/signature comparison only), INF_KINETIC (Fig 2a d7/d14/d21 time course, n=9/8/4 mice). NOT present: OBS_DIRECT, INF_TRAJECTORY. Critical qualifier the row omitted: at OBS_TRANSFER grade in an immunocompetent tumour-bearing host, the recovered endpoint is intILC1 (CD49a+CD49b+Eomes+), not ILC1.
adv.new_counter_evidence:
The row recorded counter_evidence FOUND but missed the two strongest items in the literature, both of which are genetically stronger than anything it cited and both of which are IN TUMOURS.

(A) NIXON BG, CHOU C, DADI S, ... RUDENSKY AY, LESLIE CS, LI MO. "Cytotoxic granzyme C-expressing ILC1s contribute to antitumor immunity and neonatal autoimmunity." Sci Immunol 2022;7(70):eabi8642. PMID 35394814, PMC9233921. This is the fate-mapping study the row asserts does not exist. Methods (retrieved from PMC9233921) verbatim: "Gzmc-tdT-T2A-iCre mice were generated by insertion of a targeting construct into the Gzmc locus by CRISPR/Cas9-mediated homologous recombination," crossed to "Rosa26-LSL-YFP" (GzmcFM); and "S1pr5-eGFP-T2A-iCre mice were generated in the same manner ... targeted the S1pr5 3' UTR," crossed to "Rosa26-LSL-YFP allele, generating S1pr5 fate-mapper mice (S1pr5FM)." S1pr5 is the canonical circulating-conventional-NK gene. Results, verbatim: "the vast majority of granzyme C-expressing cells did not have a history of S1pr5 expression"; and "splenic and liver NK cells did not express YFP (GzmcFM) and thus had no history of granzyme C expression." Plus an origin-positive transfer: "ILCp (around 4,000 cells) were transferred into one recipient Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- lymphopenic hosts," analysed "around 4 weeks after transfer," yielding granzyme C+ ILC1s. Bidirectional genetic fate mapping showing NO interconversion between NK and ILC1, plus a positive ILC-progenitor origin. Functionally it also inverts Gao: in MMTV-PyMT breast cancer, Gzmc-DTA depletion of ILC1s ACCELERATED tumour growth (n = 5-9 mice per group) — i.e. ILC1s are protective, not an escape mechanism. This is the single most damaging paper for T4 and the row does not mention it.

(B) DADI S ET AL. Cell 2016;164:365-377, PMID 26806130, PMC4733424. The row dismissed this as "MISATTRIBUTED for this claim" and then DROPPED it. That is half right and half a serious error. It is correctly not the primary source of the conversion claim. But it is powerful counter-evidence that the row scored as absent, and it PREDATES Gao by a year. Abstract, verbatim: "Non-circulating cytotoxic lymphocytes, derived from innate, TCR-alpha-beta, and TCR-gamma-delta lineages, EXPAND in early tumors. Characterized by high expression of NK1.1, CD49a, and CD103, these cells share a gene-expression signature distinct from those of conventional NK cells ... Generation of these lymphocytes is dependent on the cytokine IL-15, but NOT the transcription factor Nfil3 THAT IS REQUIRED FOR THE DIFFERENTIATION OF TUMOR-INFILTRATING NK CELLS, and IL-15 deficiency, but not Nfil3 deficiency, results in accelerated tumor growth." Three distinct hits on T4: (i) it is the canonical A.4 alternative observed directly — a PRE-EXISTING tissue-resident CD49a+ population EXPANDS in tumours; (ii) the Nfil3-independent / Nfil3-dependent dissociation is an OBS_GENETIC-grade demonstration of TWO INDEPENDENT ORIGINS in tumours (converted NK cells would necessarily be Nfil3-dependent); (iii) loss of these cells accelerates tumour growth, opposite to Gao's escape model.

(C) Additional functional contradiction the row missed: Yan J et al., "GPR34 is a metabolic immune checkpoint for ILC1-mediated antitumor immunity," Nat Immunol 2024;25:2057-2067, PMID 39358444, which opens "Type 1 innate lymphoid cells (ILC1s) are a class of tissue-resident cells with antitumor activity" and shows that de-repressing ILC1s enhances tumour control.

(D) Two-independent-origins background the row also missed: Sojka DK et al., eLife 2014;3:e01659, PMID 24714492 ("Tissue-resident natural killer (NK) cells are cell lineages distinct from thymic and conventional splenic NK cells," parabiosis + Rag-reporter) and Gasteiger G, Fan X, Dikiy S, Lee SY, Rudensky AY, Science 2015;350:981-985, PMID 26472762, PMC4720139, whose abstract states ILCs "are tissue-resident cells that were maintained and expanded LOCALLY under physiologic conditions, upon systemic perturbation of immune homeostasis and during acute helminth infection" and are "maintained by SELF-RENEWAL." Local self-renewal, established by parabiosis, is the physiological alternative source of the tumour ILC1 pool — and parabiosis is precisely the control Gao never ran.

I confirmed the row's integrity finding independently: the Author Correction (Nat Immunol 2024;25:925-926, PMID 38514890, DOI 10.1038/s41590-024-01799-9) removes Figs 5e and 6d,e and Supplementary Figs 5c,d and 8c; investigating institution QIMR Berghofer; reason verbatim "No evidence of their conduct or primary data could be confirmed. As such, the data from the underlying experiments are believed to have been fabricated or are unreliable"; Chief Editor asserts "The major finding of the paper that TGF-beta-driven conversion of NK cells into ILC1s ... remains unaffected." I also SEARCHED for a subsequent full retraction (WebSearch, retractionwatch.com and nature.com) and found NONE as of 2026-08 — the paper stands corrected, not retracted. That is a searched-and-absent result, not an assumption.
adv.crossfield_g4_findings:
The row ran ZERO cross-field searches — every one of its 24 listed searches is inside the NK/ILC1 tumour field. Rule G4 is unmet in the row. I searched the TRM, ILC and myeloid literature on the same process (circulating cell -> tissue-resident cell; TGF-beta-driven residency programming). Those fields have already adjudicated exactly this question, and they adjudicated it AGAINST the bulk-transfer design Gao used.

(1) T CELL / TRM FIELD — THE DECISIVE METHODOLOGICAL RESULT. Kok L, Dijkgraaf FE, Urbanus J, Bresser K, ... Perie L, Beltman JB, Schumacher TN. "A committed tissue-resident memory T cell precursor within the circulating CD8+ effector T cell pool." J Exp Med 2020;217(10):e20191711. PMID 32728699, PMC7537386 (OA full text archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/T4_PMC7537386.txt). Design: a ~200,000-member retroviral barcode library (BC2.0), thymocytes transduced and injected intrathymically so naive T cells are labelled WITHOUT in vitro activation; 500-1,000 barcoded naive OT-I cells transferred per recipient; skin DNA vaccination; barcode sequencing of TEFF (d12), TRM and TCIRCM (d>60); plus scRNA-seq with barcodes in the GFP 3'UTR, recovering clonal identity for 1,527 of 5,383 cells across 151 clones. Findings that bear directly on T4:
  (a) The field's canonical answer is SELECTION OF A PRE-COMMITTED SUBSET, not conversion. Verbatim: "these data reveal that, before skin entry, the ability of TEFF to form TRM is differentially and permanently imprinted at a clonal level," and "definitive evidence for the existence of a circulating TRM precursor population that commits to the TRM-fate before tissue entrance." ~29.7% of clones were TRM-biased, 16.9% TCIRCM-biased, and this was independent of clonal burst size.
  (b) THE CONTROL THAT SETTLES IT — one Gao never ran. Vaccinating LEFT and RIGHT hind-leg skin in the same mouse: if the tissue instructs conversion, the two sites should be clonally disparate; if a pre-committed precursor is selected, they should match. Result: r = 0.78 between the two anatomically separate TRM pools versus r = 0.30-0.37 between skin TRM and circulating memory. Two independent, spatially separated "tissues" drawing from the same donor pool is the cheap, decisive discriminator between selection and conversion. Gao's design has no such internal replicate — a single tumour per mouse, n=3-4 mice.
  (c) They also excluded stochastic engraftment explicitly by in-silico simulation of founder pools of three sizes, and showed it "could not explain the observed skewing." Gao offers no analogous test.
  (d) MOST DAMAGING SPECIFIC POINT: the markers Gao uses to define the converted state are, in the home field, markers of the PRE-EXISTING CIRCULATING PRECURSOR. Kok's blood-borne "TRM-like MP" effector state, present in the CIRCULATION at day 12, is "strongly enriched for core TRM signature genes, such as Itgae (CD103), ITGA1 (CD49A), and Fabp5," and shows "moderate to high expression of the IL-15 (Il2rb) and TGFbeta (Tgfbr1) receptors." CD49a/Itga1 is therefore demonstrably expressed by a minority pre-committed subset BEFORE tissue entry. Recovering CD49a+ donor cells after transfer is exactly what selection of a CD49a-poised minority predicts, and Gao's live sort gate could not have excluded it (Eomes is intracellular and requires fixation, so the "CD49a-CD49b+Eomes+" input was defined post hoc; no purity figure is reported in any legend). This converts the row's alternative from a reasonable worry into the home field's established default.

(2) TRM FIELD, ASSAY LESSON. Anderson KG, Mayer-Barber K, Sung H, ... Masopust D. "Intravascular staining for discrimination of vascular and tissue leukocytes." Nat Protoc 2014;9:209-222, PMID 24385150. The lesson: flow cytometry of enzymatically disaggregated non-lymphoid tissue systematically misassigns blood-borne and vessel-adherent lymphocytes as tissue-resident unless an intravascular label is given minutes before sacrifice. This became mandatory in TRM work after 2014. Gao's tumour digests report no intravascular labelling; donor cells scored as "in the tumour" are not separated from donor cells in tumour vasculature. Notably, Gasteiger 2015 (the ILC parabiosis paper) does cite Anderson 2014 — the ILC field adopted the control; the Gao tumour arm did not.

(3) ILC FIELD, RESIDENCY vs ORIGIN. Gasteiger et al. Science 2015 (PMID 26472762) used PARABIOSIS to show ILCs are "maintained by self-renewal in broadly different microenvironments" and only "at later time points after infection" do "cells from hematogenous sources help to partially replenish the pool." Parabiosis answers the question Gao's transfer cannot: what is the source of the resident pool in an UNMANIPULATED animal. The methodological lesson the TRM field learned the hard way and states plainly — parabiosis and chimerism establish RESIDENCY and REPLENISHMENT RATE, not the identity of the precursor; and conversely, an adoptive transfer establishes CAPACITY, not the physiological route. Gao demonstrates capacity. No parabiosis, no photoconversion (cf. Kaede), and no inducible fate map was done for the tumour ILC1 pool.

(4) MYELOID FIELD — THE EMPTY-NICHE ARTEFACT, WHICH IS WHAT GAO'S Rag2-/-gc-/- ARMS ACTUALLY MEASURE. van de Laar L, Saelens W, De Prijck S, ... Lambrecht BN, Guilliams M. "Yolk Sac Macrophages, Fetal Liver, and Adult Monocytes Can Colonize an Empty Niche and Develop into Functional Tissue-Resident Macrophages." Immunity 2016;44:755-768, PMID 26992565. Verbatim: three developmentally unrelated precursors were transferred "into the empty alveolar macrophage (AM) niche of neonatal Csf2rb(-/-) mice"; "when transferred separately, however, ALL precursors efficiently colonized the alveolar niche and generated AMs that were transcriptionally ALMOST IDENTICAL, self-maintained, and durably prevented alveolar proteinosis"; conclusion: "precursor origin does not affect the development of functional self-maintaining tissue-resident macrophages." Direct read-across: Gao's Fig 3e and Fig 4a-c transfer NK cells into Rag2-/-gc-/- hosts, which have a COMPLETELY EMPTY group-1-ILC niche. Recovering "ILC1-phenotype" donor cells there demonstrates that the niche can impose the resident phenotype on a competent precursor — the myeloid field's textbook result — and says nothing about whether NK cells are the physiological source in an intact tumour-bearing animal. Note also van de Laar's competition result: when precursors were co-transferred, one subset preferentially outgrew the others "correlating with their superior ... proliferation capacity." That is the row's selective-outgrowth alternative, demonstrated experimentally, and it maps onto Gao's own Fig 3e (intILC1s carry the highest Ki67 among group 1 ILC subsets, n=3 host mice at d7 and n=4 at d14).

(5) MYELOID FIELD, HISTORICAL PRECEDENT FOR THIS EXACT ERROR. The pre-2010 consensus that blood monocytes convert into microglia and other tissue-resident macrophages rested on bulk transfer plus irradiation-chimera data, and was overturned only when inducible genetic fate mapping was applied (Ginhoux 2010 Science; Yona 2013 and Hashimoto 2013 Immunity; reviewed by Guilliams & Scott). The failure mode was precisely Gao's: a perturbed/emptied host plus a marker-defined readout was read as ontogeny. NOT_SEARCHED disclosure: I did not re-pull those four myeloid fate-mapping methods sections individually; I searched and read van de Laar 2016 (PMID 26992565, verified via lit.py fetch) and rely on the others as field context rather than as audited primary evidence.

SYNTHESIS. All three home fields converge on the same verdict about Gao's assay: bulk congenic transfer of a marker-sorted population into a tumour, read out by the same markers, is a CAPACITY assay. In the T-cell field the equivalent conclusion was overturned by clonal barcoding, which showed pre-commitment before tissue entry — and showed that CD49a itself marks the pre-committed circulating minority. In the myeloid field the equivalent conclusion was overturned by inducible fate mapping, and empty-niche transfer was shown to homogenise phenotype irrespective of origin. In the ILC field parabiosis showed the resident pool self-renews locally. The one field that has now applied the correct tool to this exact axis — Nixon 2022's Gzmc and S1pr5 knock-in fate maps — found NO NK-to-ILC1 interconversion and an ILC-progenitor origin.

adv.load_bearing_reason:
HIGH is correct, and I can now quantify it: EuropePMC returns citedByCount = 562 for PMID 28759001. The row's named dependents check out — I verified both of the ones that were easiest to falsify. (1) Russo E, D'Aquino C, Di Censo C, ... Santoni A, Bernardini G. "Cxcr3 promotes protection from colorectal cancer liver metastasis by driving NK cell infiltration and plasticity." J Clin Invest 2025, PMID 40168086, PMC12126236 — real, OA, and its title word "plasticity" is the Gao framework applied to intratumoural CD49a+ NK cells. (2) Picant V, ... Caux C, Bendriss-Vermare N. "Interleukin-35 impairs human NK cell effector functions and induces their ILC1-like conversion with tissue residency features." Nat Commun 2025, PMID 40610398, PMC12229632 — real, OA, and its entire framing ("induces their ILC1-like conversion") is inherited from T4; if tumour ILC1-like cells are a selected pre-existing resident population rather than converted NK cells, that paper's central interpretive claim collapses to "IL-35 changes NK marker expression in vitro."

The strongest single named dependency, and the one I would put forward as the load-bearing anchor, is CORTEZ VS ET AL., "SMAD4 impedes the conversion of NK cells into ILC1-like cells by curtailing non-canonical TGF-beta signaling," Nat Immunol 2017;18:995-1003, PMID 28759002 — the back-to-back companion. I re-read its Online Methods (PMC5712491) and confirmed it contains NO adoptive transfer and NO reporter-based fate map; Ncr1-iCre and Il7r-Cre appear solely as conditional-deletion drivers with no Rosa26 reporter. Its actual phenotype is a GAIN of an ILC1-like gene signature in Smad4-deficient NK cells (microarray, n = 3 biological replicates) plus a B16-F10 tail-vein lung-focus count at day 15, with flow data "pooled from at least three independent experiments with one to three mice per genotype." The word "conversion" in its title is therefore borrowed wholesale from Gao's transfer data; strip T4 out and Cortez 2017 is an INF_MARKER knockout-signature paper whose title no longer describes its own experiments. That is a concrete, named, load-bearing dependency in the strict sense: its headline claim is not independently supported by its own methods.

I DID consider downgrading and rejected it, but I am recording the reason the downgrade is tempting: the "and this lets tumours escape" half of T4 is now supported by essentially nothing. The Author Correction removed exactly the functional-consequence panels (Fig 5e MCA carcinogenesis incidence; Fig 6d,e RM-1 lung metastasis), the field's two genetically strongest tumour studies both find the OPPOSITE function (Dadi 2016 PMID 26806130: IL-15 deficiency removing tissue-resident CD49a+ type-1 cells ACCELERATES tumour growth; Nixon 2022 PMID 35394814: Gzmc-DTA depletion of ILC1s ACCELERATES tumour growth in MMTV-PyMT, n = 5-9 mice per group), and Nat Immunol has since published GPR34 (PMID 39358444) on the premise that ILC1s have antitumour activity. So T4 is load-bearing HIGH for the CONVERSION half and load-bearing HIGH-but-contradicted for the ESCAPE half — those two halves should be graded separately downstream, which the row did not do.
adv.better_primary_source:
No better primary source exists for the INTRATUMOURAL claim; Gao et al. Nat Immunol 2017;18:1004-1015 (PMID 28759001, DOI 10.1038/ni.3800, with Author Correction PMID 38514890) remains correctly identified and I found nothing earlier or stronger for NK->ILC1 inside tumours. Three refinements to how it should be cited.

(1) FULL TEXT REMAINS UNOBTAINED AND SHOULD BE RECORDED AS SUCH, not paraphrased. I re-confirmed independently: lit.py returns ABSTRACT_ONLY, and nature.com serves only abstract + figure thumbnails behind the idp.nature.com cookie redirect. Everything auditable about the design comes from the per-figure legend pages. fulltext_available = PARTIAL is right. Sort-gate purity, antibody clones and transferred cell doses for the intratumoural arm remain unknown, which is not a cosmetic gap: the pre-existing-subset alternative turns entirely on input purity.

(2) THE CLAIM SHOULD BE SPLIT AND EACH HALF SOURCED SEPARATELY. Half A, "NK cells can acquire an intILC1 phenotype in a tumour": Gao 2017 Fig 4d-f is a genuine OBS_TRANSFER in immunocompetent congenic hosts (n=3 at d18, n=4 at d21 recipient mice) and is the correct primary. Half B, "NK cells become bona fide ILC1 in a tumour": the only donor-derived ILC1 endpoint is in the Rag2-/-gc-/- arm, so the best available primary for that is confounded by an empty niche and by lymphopenia-driven CD49a upregulation. Half C, "converted ILC1s permit tumour escape": the primary panels were REMOVED by the 2024 Author Correction and there is currently no adequate primary source at all — this half should be recorded as unsupported, not merely contested.

(3) THE CLEANEST MECHANISTIC PRIMARY IN THE FIELD IS NOT A TUMOUR PAPER, and should be co-cited with its own limits stated: Park E, Patel S, Wang Q, ... Yokoyama WM. "Toxoplasma gondii infection drives conversion of NK cells into ILC1-like cells." eLife 2019;8:e47605, PMID 31393266, PMC6703900 (OA, archived /home/user/aaa/refs/T4_PMC6703900.txt). It uses an Eomes-GFP reporter, Ncr1-iCre Eomes-fl/fl and WT:Tbx21-/- mixed bone-marrow chimeras — better tools than Gao — but it is an infection model, it states that true Eomes fate mapping was NOT achievable, and it explicitly flags of Gao's tumour cells that "There was no evidence presented that these Eomes- cells can circulate ... Moreover, it is not clear if these cells persist in the absence of tumor."

For the OPPOSING position the field's best primary sources are Nixon BG et al. Sci Immunol 2022;7:eabi8642 (PMID 35394814) and Dadi S et al. Cell 2016;164:365-377 (PMID 26806130); neither appears in the row's counter_evidence, and Nixon 2022 alone falsifies the row's statement that no true fate mapping of this axis exists.
